title: Request to toggle Bluetooth on/off via custom shortcut
line: Bluetooth can now be turned on and off with a global shortcut, by default the Bluetooth key, with an on-screen "Bluetooth On/Off" message.
explanation: Bluedevil registered no global shortcuts, so Bluetooth could only be switched from the applet or System Settings, and the Bluetooth key on keyboards did nothing in Plasma. The kded module now registers a "Toggle Bluetooth" action (category "Bluetooth" in Settings > Shortcuts, default key: the Bluetooth key) that does the same as the applet's switch (rfkill block/unblock plus adapter power) and shows Plasma's existing "Bluetooth On"/"Bluetooth Off" OSD.

commits.message:
kded: add a global shortcut to toggle Bluetooth

There was no way to turn Bluetooth on or off from the keyboard, and the
Bluetooth key did nothing. Add a "Toggle Bluetooth" global shortcut, bound
to the Bluetooth key by default, that works like the applet's switch.

BUG: 439445

media.caption: Master: searching "bluetooth" in Settings > Shortcuts finds nothing to bind
With the fix: Bluetooth > Toggle Bluetooth is listed (default: Bluetooth key); a custom Ctrl+Alt+B was added and pressing it shows "Bluetooth Off"
Pressing the Bluetooth key turns Bluetooth off, pressing it again turns it back on, each with the OSD and the tray icon following
